raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Several Ascend NPU CI tests have intermittently failed while allocating pinned host memory. Large HiCache host pools increase the allocation pressure, and the Indexer/GSM8K tests also allocate pinned host buffers.

This change reduces HiCache capacity where appropriate and enables the expandable pinned allocator in nine focused NPU tests. It is a mitigation for these allocation failures, not a claim that their underlying cause is fully resolved.

## Modifications

- Follow the existing MLA sizing policy from #43308: change the MHA test from 30 GB per rank to `1 if _is_pr_pipeline else 10`, and set both Prefill HiCache and Decode KV offload in the PD test to `2 if _is_pr_pipeline else 10`. MLA already has this sizing policy in the base branch.
- Set `PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True,pin_memory_expandable_segments:True` in the server subprocess environments for:
  - HiCache MHA and MLA.
  - PD disaggregation, on both Prefill and Decode.
  - DeepSeek-V4 and GLM-5.2 Indexer replay.
  - GLM-5 top64-pruned BF16 GSM8K.
  - Qwen3.6-35B-A3B AIME26 with 64K input and prefix reuse.
  - Expert distribution recorder modes.
  - EPLB minimum rebalancing utilization thresholds, in both server launch environments.
- Keep the changes in these nine NPU test files. There are no shared runtime/helper, workflow, or diagnostic logging changes.

The size selection follows `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME == "pull_request"`: PR-triggered runs use 1 GB per rank for MHA/MLA and 2 GB per rank for PD Prefill/Decode; other invocations use 10 GB per rank. This is a logical HiCache pool size, not a cap on all pinned allocations.

## Accuracy Tests

The existing assertions and accuracy thresholds are unchanged.

Local validation passed: Python syntax checks, Ruff lint/format checks, and `git diff --check`. The PR/non-PR size expressions were checked to resolve to 1/10 GB for MHA/MLA and 2/10 GB for both PD endpoints. No NPU model execution was performed locally.

The following results were confirmed from individual test summaries in [Nightly run 38371635452](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38371635452), at commit `66d96bfd4f`:

| Focused test | Result |
| --- | --- |
| HiCache MHA | [Passed](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38371635452/job/115211804440) |
| HiCache MLA | [Passed](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38371635452/job/115211804521) |
| DeepSeek-V4 Indexer replay | [Passed](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38371635452/job/115211804585) |
| GLM-5.2 Indexer replay | [Passed](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38371635452/job/115211804585) |
| GLM-5 top64-pruned BF16 GSM8K | [Passed](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38371635452/job/115211805039) |

No pinned host OOM was found in the completed job logs reviewed for that run. That commit contains the same six test-file contents as this PR, but also contained other changes that have since been removed. These results are supporting evidence, not a complete validation of the current head commit `3607a8df7f`.

Additional validation: individual summaries in [Nightly run 38490526535](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38490526535) confirmed all six original focused tests and the three additional allocator-configured tests passed; no OOM was found in the completed job logs reviewed. The run was replaced at the user's request before its final accuracy job completed, so it does not establish a complete clean run or two consecutive clean runs. A later run observed a default pinned OOM in the unmodified LLaDA2 Mini FDFO test; this PR does not change that test.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No controlled throughput/latency comparison or profiling was performed for this change. The CI results above do not establish the performance impact of enabling the expandable pinned allocator.

## Checklist

- [x] Code formatting and lint checked with Ruff; full pre-commit suite not run.
- [x] Existing NPU integration tests updated; no new unit test files added.
- [x] Documentation assessed: test-only configuration changes, no user-facing API change.
- [x] Complete CI validation of the cleaned-up head commit.
- [x] Follow the existing NPU test configuration style.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
